04 / Pricing

How we work with you

Milestone-Based

A straightforward fee structure priced entirely by deliverable milestones rather than hourly estimates. This guarantees predictable costs, zero hourly billing surprises, and transparency at every phase of the buildout.

Equity / Revenue Share

We replace traditional development fees with long-term incentive alignment through equity or revenue-sharing, allowing partner companies to focus on the business while we manage the technical risk.
